name: Tony's Auto Repair
hook: Your customers on Route 66 pull in without an appointment and get two ASE master techs on the car — the ones who don't know you yet could see that, your hours and your address in one tap. We built a trial version of that page. Take a look:
fakt: you've been running Tony's at 200 E Route 66 with two ASE master technicians and a team of five mechanics, customers come in without an appointment, and you handle everything from electrical work to heavy-duty gas and diesel repair and smog tests
na_stronie: your name, phone, e-mail and the Route 66 address up front, your six services in your own words (general maintenance and repair, oil change, automotive electrical repair, heavy-duty gasoline and diesel repair, body repair and body shop services, smog test and repair), online booking on weekdays and a contact form — every request lands straight in your inbox; your own photos and the rest of the services we add from you
dlaczego: Diesel, smog and off-road work are things people drive to Glendora for, and they search by phone first. A page on your own domain with your services, address and a way to reach you catches them at that moment.
